title: SAMPLE: Canon EOS R8 Mark II (for comparing the layout with reference-slides/)
note: SAMPLE ONLY: official_text below was written from Kint's reference slides so the layout can be compared one to one. It is not copied from Canon, the facts are unverified, and the reference slides contain known errors. Do not post.
official_text: Canon EOS R8 Mark II. The EOS R8 Mark II is a full-frame mirrorless camera with 5-axis in-body image stabilization of up to 7.5 stops. Electronic shutter bursts reach 40 fps. Pre-continuous capture reaches up to 20 frames. Video records 4K 60p, plus 1080p up to 180 fps. The body price is $1,899. The kit with the RF 24-50mm F4.5-6.3 IS STM lens is $2,099. Expected availability is late October. The original EOS R8 has no in-body image stabilization.
